title: AddFavorites
description: Sent once when the user clicks Add to Favorites on the topSitesPicker step. Native creates a favorite for each site, with its title, and uses its id to find the bundled icon. Skip sends nothing.

favorites.description: The picked sites, in the order the picker shows them

id.description: The site's id from the picker's sites

url.description: The URL to save as the favorite

title.description: The site's name from the picker's sites, to use as the favorite's title
